name: WINSON H.
preview: Sarah: Take care, Winson. Talk soon.

messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Morning, Winson. Shop···· is paid and nothing has shipped yet. The Bitfortun BS-4 ships October 31, with the Harlo OS Diagnostics add-on on the same order.

Your switch to the Thor P2 and the $220.99 question are still with the team. They come online today at 10am ET and you'll get their answer by email as well as here, so nothing for you to chase.

Anything else I can check while you wait?
yes, i am waiting for team for the answer by email. tq sarah
Before you go, one thing: what made the noise the deciding factor on the Thor P2, over keeping the BS-4 that was ready to ship?
I still prefer the THOR P2 because it is smaller and more suitable for my small house.

That makes sense, the P2 has a much smaller footprint.

Where in the house were you planning to put it, and is heat or noise the bigger worry in that spot?
i can put at mu living hall beside my TV. buy my bed is beside also. is a small studio

Good to know, Winson, and worth being honest with you: any of these miners has active fans, so right beside a bed it will be audible at night. People in small spaces usually run them lower, or put them on a timer overnight.

Last thing I'll ask: were you planning to leave it running 24/7, or switch it off while you sleep?

Noted, thanks Winson, that's genuinely useful to know.

When it arrives, come back here and I'll help you tune the fan and power settings for running it next to the bed. That's where most of the noise comes from, and it's adjustable.
yes pls tq. i am waiting.

Will do, Winson. Your email has the answer on the Thor P2 switch and the $220.99 once the team picks it up today, and I'm here whenever you want to go through setup.

Take care.
